name: How do I know if my sliding door lock is secure after a repair?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my sliding door lock is secure after a repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a professional repair, a secure sliding door lock should engage smoothly and fully without excessive force. The key or thumb turn should operate the mechanism without sticking or grinding. The door should not be able to be opened from the outside when locked, even with force applied. We test the lock thoroughly post-repair to ensure it meets safety and security standards. You should feel confident that the door is adequately secured, providing peace of mind for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: A secure, repaired sliding door lock engages smoothly, operates easily, and prevents the door from opening when locked. Professionals test to ensure it meets security standards.
